headline: Flat 35% off select electronics and appliances (Festival of Dreams)
description: Croma's Festival of Dreams 2026 sale gives a flat 35% off MRP on selected TVs, appliances, tablets and more, with extra bank offers and EMI on select cards.
how_to_redeem:
1. Open the Festival of Dreams page on croma.com
2. Pick a product marked with the festive offer
3. The discount shows in the price; bank offers apply at payment
terms: Valid till 18 Nov 2026 or while stocks last; select brands, categories, days, locations and products only; 35% is calculated on MRP; prices can vary by pincode.
verified_note: ✓ Official Croma Festival of Dreams page (checked 9 Oct 2026)
